title: 3D Rigid-Body Chain + Ragdoll Constraint System
prompt:
Use Three.js to implement a 3D rigid-body chain simulation, including chain swinging and a falling Ragdoll.

[Three.js Import Method (Must Be Followed Strictly)]
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>

[Scene 1: Chain (Left Side)]
A chain consisting of 20 links, suspended from (-3, 8, 0).

Each link:
- Shape: Cylinder (radius 0.1, height 0.5)
- Mass: 0.5 kg
- Connected to adjacent links through Ball-Socket Joint constraints
  Constraint definition: distance between the attachment points of two adjacent links = 0 (ideal constraint)
  Use an iterative constraint solver with 20 iterations per frame

Physical state of each link: position (x,y,z) + quaternion (qx,qy,qz,qw) + linear velocity (vx,vy,vz) + angular velocity (wx,wy,wz)

Integration method: Semi-implicit Euler
  v += dt * (gravity + constraint_forces) 
  x += dt * v
  q += 0.5 * dt * Quaternion(0, wx, wy, wz) * q
  Then normalize q

Constraint solving: Position-Based Dynamics (PBD)
  For each Ball-Socket Joint constraint, calculate the violation C = |attach_point_A - attach_point_B|
  Push the two rigid bodies back along the violation direction according to their mass ratio
  Iterate 20 times

The top of the chain is fixed. Clicking the scene applies a horizontal impulse to the end of the chain (magnitude 50 N·s).

[Scene 2: Ragdoll (Right Side)]
A simplified Ragdoll consisting of 10 rigid bodies:
- Head: Sphere (r=0.15, mass=3kg)
- Torso: Box (0.3×0.5×0.2, mass=10kg)
- Upper arms ×2: Cylinders (r=0.06, h=0.3, mass=2kg)
- Lower arms ×2: Cylinders (r=0.05, h=0.3, mass=1.5kg)
- Upper legs ×2: Cylinders (r=0.08, h=0.4, mass=3kg)
- Lower legs ×2: Cylinders (r=0.06, h=0.4, mass=2kg)

Joint constraints:
- Head-Torso: Ball-Socket Joint, angular limit ±30°
- Torso-UpperArm: Ball-Socket Joint, angular limit ±90°
- UpperArm-LowerArm: Hinge, range 0°-150°
- Torso-UpperLeg: Ball-Socket Joint, angular limit ±60°
- UpperLeg-LowerLeg: Hinge, range 0°-150°

Initial state: The Ragdoll stands at (3, 6, 0). Clicking applies an impulse in a random direction to the Ragdoll, causing it to fall over.

Ground collision: y = 0 plane. Rigid bodies bounce when they hit the ground (restitution = 0.2).

[Rendering]
(1) Chain links alternate between gold and silver
(2) Different colors for each Ragdoll part (skin-colored spherical head, blue torso, gray limbs)
(3) Represent constraint joints with small spheres
(4) Ground grid
(5) OrbitControls

[HUD and Controls]
(6) HUD:
  - Simulation time (id="simTime")
  - Chain-end y-coordinate (id="chainTipY")
  - Ragdoll torso y-coordinate (id="torsoY")
  - Maximum constraint violation (id="maxViolation")

(7) Reset button (id="resetBtn")
(8) Kick Chain button (id="kickChainBtn")
(9) Kick Ragdoll button (id="kickRagdollBtn")

[State Exposure]
window.__3D_STATE__:
  - simTime: simulation time
  - chain: array [{x,y,z, vx,vy,vz}] (20 entries)
  - chainTipY: y-coordinate of the chain end
  - ragdoll: { head:{x,y,z}, torso:{x,y,z}, limbs:[{x,y,z}×8] }
  - torsoY: torso y-coordinate
  - maxConstraintViolation: maximum violation among all constraints
  - avgConstraintViolation: average constraint violation
  - totalEnergy: total mechanical energy = Σ(0.5mv² + mgy)

Output a single HTML file.
